recipe.title: Lemon–tahini tofu & broccoli roast
recipe.description: Crisp-edged potatoes and roasted greens with a nutty, lemony finish.
recipe.prepNote: Keep sauces and crisp finishes separate until serving. Review the instructions before batch cooking.
recipe.rationale: Roasting gives the vegetables browned edges; tahini adds a creamy contrast and lemon gives the finish an acidic note.
recipe.storageNote: Refrigerate cooked components promptly in shallow containers, within 2 hours. Keep at 4°C or colder; use within 2–3 days or freeze. Reheat cooked leftovers to 74°C. Keep cold toppings separate. Count storage from the original preparation, not reassembly.
recipe.source: Vibe Cooking exploration pack v1. Original recipe draft, not kitchen-tested. Food-safety references: docs/RECIPE-PACK.md.

servings.capacity: Two large sheet pans with food in a single layer. Swap oven shelves midway.

ingredients.preparation: firm; drain, pat dry and cube
cut into small florets; dry after washing

steps.title: Start the potatoes
steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the potatoes with half the oil and half the salt on one of two large sheet pans. Roast for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add tofu and broccoli
steps.instruction: Toss tofu and broccoli with the remaining oil and salt. Spread them over the second pan; spread some broccoli beside the potatoes if needed. Keep a single uncrowded layer. Roast both pans for another 20–25 minutes, turning once and swapping shelf positions, until potatoes are tender and the tofu has browned edges.

steps.title: Mix the tahini sauce
steps.instruction: Whisk tahini, lemon juice, cumin and the listed water. Add a little more water only if needed for a pourable sauce.

steps.title: Finish in three different bowls
steps.instruction: Divide cooked tofu, broccoli and potatoes into three portions. Spoon on the sauce and parsley at serving time. For meal prep, cool the cooked ingredients promptly and refrigerate sauce separately.

servings.capacity: A 28 cm frying pan with a lid plus a 3 litre saucepan. Brown tofu in two batches.

ingredients.preparation: firm; drain, pat dry and cube
cut into small florets; dry after washing

steps.title: Cook the potatoes
steps.instruction: Cover the potato cubes with water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 10–15 minutes until tender. Drain.

steps.title: Brown the tofu in batches
steps.instruction: Use half the oil across two batches in a 28 cm frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook tofu for 7–9 minutes per batch, turning to brown several sides. Transfer to a clean plate.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli
steps.instruction: Add the remaining oil and broccoli to the pan. Add 60 ml extra cooking water, cover and steam for 4–6 minutes until just tender, then uncover. Work in two batches if crowded. Add the potatoes and tofu, season with the listed salt and warm through.

steps.title: Dress and serve
steps.instruction: Whisk tahini, lemon juice, cumin and the separately listed sauce water. Divide the cooked ingredients into three portions and add sauce and parsley when serving.

servings.capacity: A small non-stick frying pan and a toaster.

ingredients.preparation: cracked into a bowl and beaten

steps.title: Mix the finish
steps.instruction: Stir the yoghurt and lime juice together in a small bowl. Toast the bread.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a small non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted and excess water evaporates.

steps.title: Scramble the eggs
steps.instruction: Beat the eggs with paprika and the listed salt. Pour into the pan, reduce the heat and stir gently until fully set; check the egg mixture reaches 74°C.

steps.title: Assemble breakfast
steps.instruction: Spoon the eggs onto the toast and add the lime yoghurt. Serve immediately. Keep cooked eggs and cold toppings separate when storing.
